title: Senior Business Consultant - Commercial
description:
Job Title: Senior Business Consultant - Commercial
Job Location: Paris, France
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:

Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and Business Consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision and values, and status as a public benefit corporation on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Veeva Business Consulting was launched in 2019 and has grown quickly and organically to a global organization of over 400 people. Our team is focused on making the life sciences industry more efficient and effective through software, data, and consulting working together.

We expect significant growth in Business Consulting as we look towards 2030, and are looking for great people to make it happen.

The Role
As a Senior Consultant in our Commercial Business Consulting practice, you won’t just advise on the future of Life Sciences - you’ll be building it. We help our customers bring treatments to patients faster by fundamentally transforming their operating models, powered by the industry’s most advanced technology, AI and data. Unlike traditional firms, we move beyond "slides and theory" to deliver tangible, scalable execution that others simply cannot replicate.
What You’ll Do

•
Project Leadership: Act as the Lead for small-scale projects, managing end-to-end design and delivery of high-quality customer solutions

•
Team Management: Lead project teams of 2-3 consultants, developing your people leadership skills in a project setting

•
Business Development: Drive practice growth by leading proposal development and identifying new opportunities within your engagements

•
Strategic Problem Solving: Solve complex challenges for Life Sciences leaders by leveraging Veeva’s unique data, software, and AI insights

•
Subject Matter Expertise: Support multiple projects across Commercial BC while developing deep expertise in 1-2 specific functional areas

Requirements

•
Experience: 5+ years in Life Sciences Consulting (Business or Management Consulting preferred)

•
Domain Knowledge: Proven expertise in two or three of the following areas: Go-to-Market strategy, Brand Planning, Product Launch, Omnichannel strategy, Segmentation and targeting

•
Analytical Rigor: A strong mindset for both quantitative and qualitative reasoning

•
Communication: Ability to articulate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher

Nice to Have

• Knowledge of Veeva products

• Experience delivering SaaS or Tech-enabled consulting solutions

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

• Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

• If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

•
Compensation: Highly competitive salary and equity in Veeva

•
Growth: Unrivalled career progression in a fast-growing, global team

•
Flexibility: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can work from home or the office on any given day

Compensation

• Total compensation: 76,000 - 125,000 EUR

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
The Decision Advantage within Defense at Leidos has an immediate opening for a DevSecOps Engineer on the Systems Engineering & Integration Contract (SEIC II), supporting Air Force Mission Planning with F-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) & Navy partners. You will be joining a dynamic DevSecOps team that is delivering numerous next generation Mission Planning solutions into a variety of environments. This is an exciting opportunity to work on cutting edge technologies meeting the diverse and expansive set of Mission Planning requirements.
Primary Responsibilities

• Design, develop, maintain, and debug advanced pipeline software supporting automated software builds, deployments, quality gates, and automated test workflows across complex delivery environments.

• Provide technical expertise for sub-projects within the team related to composition, configuration, deployment, and validation of software products for user evaluation, integration & automated testing.

• Develop sophisticated pipeline automation, including custom quality gate logic and API-based integrations with industry-standard DevOps, CI/CD, security, and test automation tooling.

• Define, implement, and improve DevOps processes and toolchain integrations to enable reliable CI/CD across multiple technical areas and environments.

• Design, compose, configure, and maintain Helm product charts, including advanced Helm template development, deployment validation, troubleshooting, and optimization within Kubernetes.

• Integrate, deploy, and troubleshoot microservices-based architectures across Kubernetes-based platforms, including K8s, K3s, RKE2, and related container orchestration environments.

• Develop and improve automated versioning, release management, configuration management, and environment provisioning capabilities to support repeatable and scalable software delivery.

• Design and implement automated virtual machine provisioning, configuration, deployment, and lifecycle workflows using cloud provider APIs and infrastructure automation practices.

• Diagnose and resolve complex Kubernetes, containerized application, virtual machine, deployment, integration, and pipeline issues spanning multiple systems, tools, and technical disciplines.

• Provide technical expertise and guidance to team members on DevOps practices, deployment architecture, automation design, troubleshooting approaches, and solution implementation.

• Communicate clearly and proactively with internal team members, project leads, technical stakeholders, and external partners via messaging platforms, discussions, documentation, and status updates.

• Influence project and team decisions by recommending technical approaches, identifying risks, proposing process improvements, and ensuring delivery solutions meet program objectives and quality expectations.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a closely related field or equivalent years of experience. Additional years of experience will be considered in lieu of degree.

• 8+ years Software Engineering experience in any object-oriented programming language

• U.S. Citizenship required, no dual citizenship.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain Secret clearance

• Must have the ability to obtain a CompTIA Security+ (Sec+) certification within 30 days of employment

• Strong software engineering background with demonstrated experience developing, integrating, and troubleshooting web-based systems, APIs, and distributed or microservice-based architectures.

• 3+ years working in a DevSecOps environment & familiarity with DevSecOps best practices

• Experience with branching & pull request workflows using software version control and repo tools

• Ability to work in both Linux & Windows Operating Systems

• Bash/Shell Scripting Experience

• Experience with one or more Kubernetes cluster types (e.g., AKS (most preferred), EKS, GKE, OpenShift, K3s, RKE2s, Minikube) and Kubernetes applications (e.g., Kubectl, Helm, Rancher).

title: Marketing Specialist - Global
description:
Overview
Lifeway is seeking a bilingual Marketing Specialist to lead the execution of marketing campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, and revenue for Lifeway's Spanish-language resources, products, and events among Spanish-speaking audiences worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of cultural strategy and hands-on campaign execution, collaborating with authors, creative vendors, and internal teams across both domestic and international markets. You will contribute research-informed insights to strategic planning discussions while ensuring every campaign touchpoint is linguistically accurate, culturally resonant, and on-brand. If you are passionate about reaching Spanish-speaking communities with gospel-centered content, this is a unique opportunity to make a global impact from a mission-driven organization.
Why Lifeway?
Lifeway is a place where you can bring your faith and work experience to join in the most important mission in the world: making disciples of Jesus Christ. Whether you’re a creator or storyteller, data guru or problem-solver, or anywhere in between, if you’re passionate about serving the church, we have a place for you. Lifeway has a strong Work from Anywhere (WFA) culture that is deeply focused on our mission and values. While headquartered in Nashville, TN, many of our positions are remote-eligible and have autonomy and flexibility with work hours. We provide equipment and resources to ensure team members have access to a productive and ergonomic workspace. We believe building relationships and community is essential to how we work together, so Lifeway hosts all-team meetings several times per year and provides travel for key team gatherings for remote-based team members. Full-time employees are eligible for enrollment in our comprehensive benefits plans including healthcare, vacation and sick time, holiday pay, care days, 401(k) plan, maternity and parental leave, adoption assistance, mission trip time, and more. If this sounds like a place where you would be excited to serve the kingdom of God, we would love for you to join our team.
Learn more about our culture at team.lifeway.com/culture-code
This is a remote position in the U.S. with occasional travel to Nashville for in-person team gatherings.
Responsibilities

• Lives out Lifeway’s mission and values, showing deep commitment to Kingdom work

• Executes marketing campaigns and tactics for the Spanish-speaking/global market, including formatting and producing content such as email, social, print, sales presentations, conference materials, catalogs, and author acquisition assets.

• Coordinates with internal teams, authors, vendors, and creative partners -- domestic and international -- to gather inputs, route deliverables, and ensure content is culturally relevant and linguistically accurate for Spanish-speaking audiences.

• Supports research and analysis activities -- including surveys, market trend tracking, and customer insights -- to help inform marketing strategies and messaging for the Spanish-speaking market.

• Assists with vendor, author, and ministry-partner coordination specific to the Spanish-speaking/global market, including scheduling, translation review, and relationship follow-up.

• Participates in strategic planning discussions for the Spanish resource area, contributing executional insights and research-based input to inform campaign direction.

• Tracks campaign timelines, collects performance data, and flags issues to managers.

• Monitors assigned Spanish-language social media or other marketing channels and reports on engagement trends as part of ongoing social listening efforts.

• Maintains marketing calendars and inputs content into internal project management and campaign management tools.

• Shares learnings and process improvements with peers and actively participates in team knowledge sharing.

• Limited travel: 2-4 times per year, typically overnight

Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Com

title: Technical Co-founder (CTO) - AI Legal Front Desk
description:
The Opportunity
Solo practitioners and small law firms still lose work the same way: missed calls, slow callbacks, and intake handled between hearings. Hiring is no answer - payroll, training, and turnover are exactly what these firms cannot absorb.
Problem and solution validation are complete. Multiple live pilots are entering production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, and scalability. The teams that ship credible AI workers into trust-sensitive verticals in the next 18 months will define the category. We intend to be one of them.
The Venture
BloomLex is a managed AI staffing platform that delivers AI workers as fully-set-up hires - trained, monitored, and continuously improved by our team. Rather than another self-serve SaaS tool, BloomLex operates as a Role-as-a-Service business: lawyers evaluate us on outcomes - time saved, calls answered, consults booked - not configuration effort.
Our first hire, Ava, is an AI Front Desk that answers calls 24/7, captures structured intake, books consultations, and performs outbound callbacks, without creating new operational burden for the lawyer. The roadmap expands from the front desk into adjacent AI staff roles, all delivered through the same managed model.
The Partnership
The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, and live pilots are running. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder - a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership stake.
This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.
What you'll own
As Co-Founder & CTO, you will write the first lines of production code, set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

• Architecture & Reliability - Harden Ava's voice and workflow systems for in-production reliability. Establish core architecture, observability, and audit-trail standards

• RaaS Delivery Layer - Build the internal infrastructure that lets the team configure, monitor, and optimize AI performance without scaling engineering headcount

• Unit Economics - Own the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call, and lock in unit economics within the $499/month pricing model

• Customer & Market - Represent the company in front of lawyers, partners, and investors as the technical voice of the venture

• Roadmap - Convert pilots into paying customers, expand the AI staff beyond the front desk, and begin a path toward custom and self-hosted models where legal and privacy requirements demand it

• Team - Recruit and lead the founding engineering team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

• Shipped LLM-powered and voice systems into production environments where incorrect outputs carried real consequences

• Full-stack confidence across applied LLMs, real-time voice and conversational AI, telephony, human-in-the-loop workflows, observability, and secure multi-tenant SaaS

• Well-formed convictions about reliability engineering, edge-case management, and the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call

• Experience building managed and service-heavy platforms, with the discipline to scale delivery without scaling engineering headcount

• Prepared to operate as a principal - including saying "this won't scale" or "this isn't ready" when the integrity of the product requires it

• Strongly preferred: prior founder or early-stage technical leadership experience; background in legal tech, healthcare, or another trust-sensitive vertical; capability to self-host custom models to meet legal and privacy needs

title: Database Architect — Oracle & PostgreSQL, Cloud Migration
description:
OpsGuru is a global engineering and consulting group. We are experts in the container ecosystem, data processing and analytics, and cloud-native technologies. Our team is formed by network, data, security, DevOps specialists and application developers. OpsGuru empowers customers with technology to solve their business problems and provide the tools to assure success in their digital transformation.
About the role
We're looking for a Database Architect who owns the data tier end to end on enterprise cloud engagements - and who is equally deep in Oracle and PostgreSQL, because the work sits squarely between them.
Most of our engagements start with a working-but-aging system: an Oracle database carrying a decade of business logic in PL/SQL packages nobody has read recently, supporting applications that cannot go down. They end with a supportable, well-instrumented PostgreSQL platform on cloud infrastructure that costs less to run and that a managed operations team can actually keep healthy. Between those two points sit the decisions that determine whether the program succeeds: target-state design, sequencing, what gets converted versus rewritten versus retired, how cutover happens, and what the rollback looks like.
This is the person accountable for those decisions. You will set the technical direction for database migration and modernization work, defend it to client architects and executives, and stay close enough to the implementation to catch the problems early. It is an architecture role that has not stopped being hands-on - you are expected to open a plan, read a trace, and prove the point yourself rather than delegate the diagnosis.
You will also help shape how we deliver this work: reference architectures, migration patterns, estimation models, and standards that make the next engagement faster than the last one.
What you'll do

• Own the architecture of the data tier across migration and modernization programs - current-state assessment, target-state design, migration strategy, sequencing, risk, and effort - and be accountable for the outcome, not just the design document.

• Make and defend the hard calls: convert versus rewrite versus retire, RDS versus Aurora versus self-managed, single cutover versus phased coexistence, where to spend money on performance and where not to.

• Design Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migrations in full: schema conversion, PL/SQL to PL/pgSQL strategy, data type and collation mismatch resolution, query rewrite patterns, and the performance validation that proves the target holds under real load.

• Plan cutovers that minimize downtime - CDC-based replication, dual-run and output-comparison approaches, rehearsals, go/no-go criteria, and a rollback plan you would genuinely be willing to execute.

• Stay hands-on where it counts: diagnose performance problems yourself, read execution plans, isolate whether the bottleneck is SQL, schema, statistics, configuration, storage, or application access pattern, and land the fix with evidence behind it.

• Architect the database platform on cloud infrastructure - sizing, HA and failover topology, backup and recovery, patching and version strategy, encryption and key management, observability, and cost optimization.

• Define the operational model handed to managed services: runbooks, monitoring and alerting standards, escalation paths, and the health checks that catch problems before the client does.

• Act as the senior technical voice with clients - lead architecture and design sessions, present to client architects and executive stakeholders, translate trade-offs into business terms, and hold the line when a requested shortcut creates real risk.

• Support pre-sales and delivery planning: scope database workstreams, size effort, contribute to proposals and statements of work, and flag the assumptions that will break the estimate if they turn out to be wrong.

• Build reusable assets - reference architectures, migration playbooks, conversion patterns, assessme

title: Security GRC Lead
description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

You'll be the first GRC hire at a company that processes some of the most sensitive data on earth: training data, evals, and human-feedback pipelines for the frontier AI labs, plus payments and KYC for 300K+ experts. Compliance posture is a sales gate for every $50M+ contract Mercor signs. The audit calendar never ends.

This is not an audit-theater role. You'll own the operating cadence of a continuously-audited company: continuous SOC 2 monitoring in Vanta, the active ISO 27001 buildout, an annual KPMG-style customer audit every quarter, and a sub-48-hour questionnaire SLA. You'll write controls in code where it makes sense, push back on tools that fight you, and own the artifacts that close enterprise deals.

We use AI heavily in our own GRC work - Vanta has an MCP, our questionnaire bank is queryable, evidence is automated where the framework allows it. You should be comfortable using LLMs to draft, review, and respond at speed. If you've ever copy-pasted the same answer into 14 vendor questionnaires by hand, you'll appreciate not having to.

We're in-person five days a week at our SF headquarters, with first Fridays remote.

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD

- The Mercor compliance operating cadence: SOC 2 Type 2 (continuous), ISO 27001 (standing up now), and the next two frameworks customers ask for (HIPAA, FedRAMP Moderate, EU AI Act conformity - your call on sequencing)

- A customer-audit machine that responds to Anthropic, Google, Meta, NVIDIA, and OpenAI without burning out the security team - questionnaire SLA under 48h, KPMG-grade evidence packs on demand

- The third-party risk program - formal intake, recurring review cadence, evidence requirements - tied into procurement so vendors can't be onboarded around it

- Policy lifecycle owned end-to-end: version, attestation, exception handling, review cycle - not a SharePoint graveyard

- Controls-as-code where it makes sense: Vanta integrations, Wiz policy packs, Panther rules tied to SOC 2 CC categories, automated evidence collection

- Data-handling procedures: the customer-data-deletion gap, DSAR workflow, KMS scheduled destruction, offboarding handlers

- The internal trust narrative: customer trust pages, security one-pagers, executive-ready disclosure templates when something goes sideways

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 7+ years in security GRC, compliance engineering, or audit, with at least 2 years owning a SOC 2 Type 2 program end-to-end at a company under audit by enterprise customers

- You've shipped at least one ISO 27001 certification from kickoff to issued certificate, including Stage 1 and Stage 2 with a real registrar

- Fluent in Vanta (or Drata, Secureframe, Sprinto) at the integration and admin level, not just the reviewer UI - you've configured connectors, written custom tests, debugged broken evidence

- You've sat on the company side of at least one enterprise customer audit conducted by a Big 4 firm (KPMG, EY, Deloitte, PwC) on behalf of a frontier custom

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Why Weave Exists

At Weave, our mission is to evolve how therapeutic knowledge is captured, transformed, and communicated throughout drug development. We do this by equipping human experts with AI instruments to enable drugs to be brought to patients as rapidly, safely, and inexpensively as possible.

The Weave Platform streamlines regulatory workflows from start to finish by intelligently, creatively, and effectively infusing every step with AI. Together with our customers, Weave is designing and building the AI workbench for the entire therapeutic lifecycle.

The Role & Your Mission
We are seeking our inaugural Forward Deployed Engineer , reporting to our Director of Customer Success. This is a unique and pivotal role that requires a person of uncommon skills and disposition. You will own technical implementation for our customers - configure Weave’s core “Regulatory AI Templates” with a combination of AI and your regulatory experience, lead complex integrations and map data flows, ensure early stage customer satisfaction, and enable customers with the basics of how to lead future configuration projects as they move out of their onboarding phase.
This role is heavily and directly engaged with customers and requires an ability to work effectively and efficiently with LLM prompts to produce high quality scientific/regulatory documents. It entails tight collaboration with customers and Weave’s GTM and Product teams.
What You'll Own

•
Customer template customization: Our core templates are a good place to start, but many of our customers require customization to accommodate their style, brand, modality, and scientific idiosyncrasies. You will work with customers to customize templates to their needs

•
Prompt coaching: Ultimately we want our customers to be self-sufficient in maintaining their templates. You will help them overcome trepidation and develop the ability and structure to do so.

•
Ecosystem integration: You will collaborate with diverse stakeholder groups spanning IT, Regulatory Affairs & Ops, and Medical Writing teams to architect seamless data bridges between Weave and critical enterprise platforms, including systems of record and publishing platforms

•
Handbook creation: You will document best practices and situational tips for technical implementation for internal and external purposes.

What You’ll Bring

•
Prompt Artist and Pragmatist: You have experience building repeatable prompt/template systems (not one-off chats), evaluating output quality systematically, you know how to effectively manage failure modes (hallucination, context limits) in high-stakes regulated documents.

•
Technical System Connector: You possess practical experience navigating REST APIs and Webhooks. You can parse API documentation, validate endpoints, and master various authentication flows with ease.

•
Scientifically Conversant: You’ve got scientific wherewithal. You’ve been involved with drug development, you’re an SME in something, and what you don’t know you can pick up quickly. You know what these mean: CMC, CSR, HAQ, ICH, IND, NDA, eCTD.

•
Customer Lover: You thrive on working with customers, helping them solve their problems, and finding success.

•
Outstanding Educator and Communicator: Educating isn’t a chore for you, it’s a joy. You love to see people “get it” and enjoy the craft of figuring out how to help them get there.

•
Builder: You relish uncharted territory and yearn to build a cabin in it (figuratively speaking).

• 5+ years experience in B2B SaaS or in bio industries (e.g., drug co., CRO/CDMO), ideally in technical/software roles

• Experience serving therapeutics, life science, or bio markets strongly preferred

• Drug-related (e.g., bio, chem) education preferred, advanced degree ideal

What We Offer
🎯 The opportunity to work at a modern, cutting-edge healthcare technology company devoted to meaningful positive impact on human life. Collaboration, velocity, and customer obsession are our baseline, demonstration

description:

About the Role
As a Medical Administrative & Surgical Patient Coordinator, you will own the administrative coordination that happens after a patient begins moving through the surgical process. You will make sure required clearances, testing, records, appointments, documentation, and pre-operative steps are completed so patients stay on track for surgery.
This is an operations-focused healthcare role, not a sales position and not a remote clinical position. You will work directly with patients, medical offices, imaging centers, laboratories, hospitals, and other healthcare providers while knowing when a question or concern needs to be escalated to clinical staff. You will receive training on the practice's specific workflows and gradually take ownership of a critical part of the patient journey.
Responsibilities

• Own and track the pre-operative process for multiple surgical patients from booking through readiness for surgery.

• Keep each patient's pre-operative checklist current, identifying missing clearances, tests, records, documentation, and other requirements before they become delays.

• Coordinate required appointments and testing, including imaging, medical clearances, laboratory work, and other pre-operative requirements.

• Contact hospitals, imaging centers, laboratories, physicians' offices, and other healthcare facilities to obtain outstanding information and keep cases moving.

• Follow up persistently with outside providers when testing, records, or clearances are delayed, advocating for patients while maintaining professional communication.

• Conduct or support standardized pre-operative patient calls and clearly walk patients through established non-clinical instructions and next steps.

• Maintain accurate documentation of patient conversations, completed requirements, pending items, and case status within the appropriate systems.

• Communicate surgical readiness, outstanding requirements, and potential delays clearly to the broader practice team.

• Recognize clinical questions, unusual circumstances, or concerns that fall outside your administrative scope and escalate them promptly rather than providing independent medical advice.

• Provide additional medical administrative and patient-coordination support when needed to improve the efficiency of the surgical process.

Requirements

Must-Have:

• 3+ years of experience in medical administration, surgical coordination, patient coordination, pre-operative coordination, or closely related healthcare operations.

• Hands-on experience working in a U.S. medical practice or healthcare environment.

• Direct experience coordinating surgical or pre-operative patients, including appointments, tests, medical records, clearances, or required documentation.

• Experience using EMR, CRM, patient-management, or comparable medical-office systems.

• Confidence communicating directly with patients and contacting hospitals, imaging centers, laboratories, physicians' offices, and other healthcare providers.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with strong documentation, organization, case-tracking, and follow-through skills.

• Sound judgment regarding administrative versus clinical responsibilities, including knowing when an issue must be escalated to clinical staff.

Nice to Have:

• Experience in plastic surgery, cosmetic surgery, aesthetics, or another high-touch private-pay medical environment.

• Medical Assistant training, nursing-related education, healthcare education, or equivalent clinical-office experience.

• Experience conducting standardized pre-operative patient calls.

description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is seeking a Scientist II / Senior Scientist, Electron Diffraction Characterization to join the Materials Science team within the Autonomous Science Platform. The Autonomous Science Platform combines experimental science, automation, AI, and software to accelerate materials discovery. This role turns electron diffraction and microstructure measurements into trusted, machine-readable data that supports crystal structure determination, materials characterization, automated workflows, and model development.

You will lead method development, validation, and operation for electron diffraction characterization workflows, with emphasis on micro-ED and/or EBSD. You will prepare samples, run measurements, interpret diffraction and microstructure data, troubleshoot data-quality issues, and establish workflows that make characterization outputs accurate, reproducible, and fit for purpose.

You will also translate electron diffraction expertise into scalable analyzer pipelines. Partnering with ML, software, automation, and experimental teams, you will define metadata, quality-control checks, provenance, and analysis workflows that make diffraction data reliable, traceable, and useful at scale.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on expertise in electron diffraction characterization with strong scientific judgment and a commitment to high-quality data. They can operate at the instrument, interpret complex structural and microstructural outputs, and help build the analytical infrastructure needed to scale characterization across Lila’s platform.

What You'll Be Building

• Lead micro-ED and other electron microscopy characterization workflows for materials discovery programs.

• Develop methods for crystal structure determination and microstructure analysis.

• Prepare samples, run measurements, interpret data, and troubleshoot quality issues.

• Define calibration, validation, QC, and reproducibility standards for electron diffraction workflows.

• Build structured, traceable diffraction outputs for downstream analysis and modeling.

• Partner with ML, software, automation, and experimental teams on analyzer pipelines.

• Translate project needs into fit-for-purpose characterization methods and analysis plans.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Applied Physics, Engineering, or a related field, or M.S. with equivalent hands-on characterization experience.

• Hands-on expertise in SEM and TEM including advanced diffraction analysis such as micro-ED.

• Strong understanding of diffraction principles, crystallography, crystal structure determination, and microstructure analysis.

• Experience preparing samples, validating methods, interpreting diffraction data, and troubleshooting workflow issues.

• Ability to translate characterization workflows into reliable, structured, machine-readable data.

• Experience collaborating across scientific, ML, software, automation, or data teams.

• Clear communication skills for documenting methods, explaining results, and driving cross-functional decisions.

Bonus Points For

• Experience with other EM techniques including EBSD, 4D-STEM is a plus.

• Familiarity with automated or high-throughput characterization workflows.

• Proficiency with Python or similar tools for scientific data analysis.

• Experience integrating instrument data with ML-ready datasets or analyzer workflows.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. title: Senior Principal Inbound Product Manager, CRM Voice AI
description:
How We Work:
We work in pods - small, dedicated teams embedded with a single enterprise customer, building their voice agents from first call to self-sufficiency. A pod owns the full lifecycle: agent shadowing, conversation design, build, production go-live, and the handoff that makes the customer self-sufficient so the pod can move on to the next one. Each pod pairs forward-deployed engineers with a product manager who owns both the customer outcome and the product learning that comes from it.
Every PM on this team runs at least one pod directly and has visibility across others. You're in the customer's world - on their calls, in their systems, solving their problems - while simultaneously shaping what the product becomes. The learnings from your pods feed directly into the platform roadmap and into repeatable, productized assets that scale beyond any single customer.
What This Role Owns:

• You run one pod directly - one of our most complex customer engagements - and float across two others, providing product direction and unblocking teams. But the pod work is only half the job.

• Your primary technical focus is the conversational experience itself: dialog quality, turn-taking, interruption handling, barge-in behavior, and endpointing. You collaborate directly with the platform voice team on voice pipeline innovation, the low-latency infrastructure that makes a voice agent feel like a conversation rather than a bot reading a script. When the platform team is making stack decisions about real-time streaming, LLM orchestration, or voice-to-voice model integration, you're in the room with production customer data and real-world edge cases that no one else has.

• You also own an industry vertical. As we scale across customers, you evaluate which patterns, intents, and conversation flows can be productized into out-of-the-box voice content for a specific industry. You're turning one-off wins into repeatable assets, and you have the customer exposure to know which abstractions actually hold.

Why This and Not Somewhere Else:
You're not choosing between startup speed and enterprise scale. You get both. This team ships voice AI in production with real enterprise customers, with the same urgency and ownership you'd find at a startup, backed by a platform that supports 85% of the Fortune 500. You have a direct seat at the platform table, influencing voice infrastructure decisions with data from your own deployments. This role puts you in a customer's contact center debugging a live voice agent one day and shaping platform architecture decisions the next. That combination is rare, and it's why this team exists.
What You Bring:

• 12+ years of product management experience, with recent hands-on work shipping voice AI or conversational AI products. What you've shipped in the last 12-18 months matters more than total years.

• Fluency with the voice stack: ASR, TTS, streaming pipelines, latency optimization, endpointing, barge-in, turn-taking. You've made real tradeoff decisions here, not just evaluated vendor demos.

• Experience with telephony integration: SIP, call transfers, IVR systems, or CCaaS platforms.

• Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical deployments - not from a distance, but in their environment, on their calls, solving their problems.

• Strong opinions on what makes a voice conversation feel human, backed by experience building or evaluating conversational systems.

• Technical depth in LLM orchestration for real-time conversational use cases.

Even Better:

• A track record of productizing customer-specific solutions into repeatable, industry-level assets.

• Industry expertise in verticals with high contact center volume: telecommunications, financial services, travel, healthcare.

• Experience defining voice-specific evaluations such as task completion, latency, transcription accuracy, and conversational quality.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $190,900 - $334,100

DEPT® is seeking a highly technical, consultative, and hands-on Architect, Software Engineering (AEM) to join our forward-deployed architecture squad in North America. Mapped back to our Web Craft, this role is a specialized engineering seat focused on Adobe Experience Manager excellence. You will step directly into complex client environments to execute deep-dive code audits, optimize rendering speeds, and resolve complex web and DAM architecture blockages.

This is a hands-on technical execution role. You will work in tight sprint windows to remediate technical debt, configure AEM permission pathways, and execute migration tasks from legacy architectures to AEM as a Cloud Service (AEMaCS), restoring customer confidence and establishing technical stability.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

•
Perform Code & Performance Audits: Execute deep AEM code reviews and implement targeted performance optimizations (Core Web Vitals, Dispatcher/CDN caching rules, edge routing, and bundle size reduction).

•
Deliver Cloud Migrations: Lead hands-on technical migration tasks to transition legacy, on-prem, or Adobe Managed Services (AMS) web environments to AEM as a Cloud Service (AEMaCS).

•
Remediate Asset Architecture: Reconfigure AEM Assets (DAM) taxonomies, metadata schemas, processing profiles, and ACL/permissions pathways to optimize large-scale asset ingestion and retrieval.

•
Implement Performant Interfaces: Build and optimize AEM content delivery using AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS), Core Components, or decoupled/headless GraphQL APIs.

•
Support Technical Handoffs: Document code fixes, establish Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for client development teams, and transition stabilized AEM codebases cleanly.

WHAT YOU BRING

•
Web Architecture Excellence: 10+ years of software engineering experience with a deep technical understanding of CDN edge routing (Fastly/Cloudflare), web caching strategies, SSO integration (SAML/OAuth), and content taxonomies.

•
Core AEM Architecture Expertise:

•
Hands-on engineering expertise across AEM Sites and AEM Assets , with proven experience in AEM as a Cloud Service (AEMaCS) as well as legacy architectures.

•
Direct experience deploying and tuning AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS) or document-based authoring for high-speed page performance.

•
Deep understanding of AEM Dispatcher configuration, OSGi service architecture, Sling models, and Oak JCR indexing/query optimization.

•
Consultative Mindset: Strong collaborative skills with the ability to work directly with client development teams, explain complex technical fixes clearly, and drive architectural best practices.

You’ll monitor live robot operations, perform hands-on troubleshooting, document incidents clearly, and partner with robotics software and hardware teams to improve uptime. • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Flexibility to begin on a standard 9am-5pm schedule and transition to first shift coverage, 6am-2pm, as fleet operating hours expand.

• Scripting experience with Python or similar tools for log review, data collection, or simple automation.

• Experience with fleet management, monitoring dashboards, telemetry tools, or issue-tracking systems.

title: Junior Electrical Engineering Technician
description:
Junior Electrical Engineering Technician
About Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions
Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions is a fast-growing defense technology company headquartered in the Tampa Bay area, Florida. Founded by U.S. and U.K. veterans, Marcurius brings decades of frontline experience across Special Operations and Intelligence missions, with deep expertise in asymmetric warfare and the real-world employment of unmanned systems.
Role Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented Junior Electrical Engineering Technician to join our electrical integration team. In this role, you will build, integrate, and test wire harnesses, low-voltage electrical systems, and autonomy components for marine applications. You will work directly with the lead electrical engineer on marine power distribution, wire sizing, network topologies, and sensitive electronics, ensuring high-quality standards for marine durability and operational reliability.
Key Responsibilities
Harness & Cable Fabrication: Build, break out, route, and terminate low-voltage wire harnesses and custom cable assemblies.
Hardware & Systems Integration: Mount and wire autonomy hardware, sensors, marine communications equipment, Ethernet switches, and CAN bus networks.
Physical Installation: Route cabling neatly through tight marine spaces, bulkheads, and conduits, ensuring proper strain relief, bend radius, and chafe protection.
Testing & Verification: Conduct continuity, pinout, voltage, and ground checks; assist engineering with troubleshooting electrical and wiring faults.
Component Assembly: Perform precision hand soldering, weather-sealing, heat shrinking, and lug crimping.
Required Qualifications
Hands-on Experience: 2+ years of electrical assembly, wire harness building, or technician experience (marine, automotive, robotics, or industrial context preferred).
Electrical Diagnostics: Experience using Digital Multimeters (DMM), bench power supplies, and signal test equipment for troubleshooting and pinout validation.
Tools & Assembly Techniques: Proficiency in precision hand soldering, heat shrinking, weather-sealing, and operating manual/hydraulic crimpers for heavy-gauge lugs.
Power Systems: Practical familiarity working with 12-48VDC and 120VAC electrical systems.
Schematics & Diagrams: Ability to accurately read and interpret electrical schematics, pinout tables, and wiring diagrams
Preferred Experience
2-3 years of experience in marine electrical systems, unmanned surface vessels (USVs), or vehicle prototyping.
Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Automotive, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Familiarity with CAN diagnostic tools (Vector CANalyzer, Kvaser, Peak PCAN, Vehicle Spy).
ABYC (American Boat and Yacht Council) Electrical Certification.
Work Environment
Primarily onsite at Marcurius facilities in Clearwater, Florida, with direct work in workshops, vessels, docks, and field-testing environments. The role supports prototype development, electrical integration, and sea-trial preparation in a fast-paced setting with changing priorities and close cooperation across engineering, software, operations, and test teams.
Why Marcurius
Marcurius is a people-first, execution-focused organization assembling a small, high-impact team of engineers and operators. This role offers the opportunity to design and field electrical systems that directly enable real-world maritime missions and help build the technical foundation of a next-generation unmanned systems company.

WHO YOU ARE

- You’re a top performer; maintaining high standards and instilling them in others

- You understand when to roll up your sleeves and when to empower your team

QUALIFICATIONS

- 6+ years of software engineering experience in a high velocity environment

- Deep experience with Typescript, NodeJS, React, AWS, PostgreSQL tech stack a plus

- Authorized to work in the US without visa sponsorship

WHAT WE OFFER

- A collaborative environment of driven teammates working to capture a unique opportunity

- An opportunity to work directly with the founders as we scale

- Competitive salary with significant upside potential through generous early-stage equity

title: Engineering Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
At Warner Music Group , we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:
• Curiosity : We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
• Collaboration : Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
• Commitment : We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights - technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog!
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds - an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
A little bit about our team:
WMG Technology’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team sits at the intersection of enterprise engineering and business enablement. We embed engineers with global business units - including Finance, HR, and our recorded music labels - to turn operational pain points into high-value AI and automation solutions.
Working directly with the business, we run a centralized intake, routing, and delivery model so the business can move in days or weeks using existing tools, while larger foundational work graduates cleanly onto the product roadmap. We set a shared technical bar, reuse what already works, and keep AI deployments secure, cost-transparent, and maintainable.
Your role:

Reporting to the Director of FDE & AI Optimization, the Engineering Manager will lead a team of embedded engineers and own how FDE work is taken in, built, reused, and graduated.

This is a hands-on people-manager role. You will coach engineers who sit inside lines of business while holding a centralized technical reporting structure, operating playbook, and delivery standard. You will partner with Data Engineer, Product Owner, and business sponsors to turn ambiguous requests into a clear, repeatable operating model - and to make sure FDE is a trusted path for AI optimization, not a shadow-IT queue.

The ideal manager brings an equal blend of technical judgment and organizational empathy: comfortable in the tools, rigorous about routing and reuse, and able to help non-technical stakeholders translate operational pain points into work the team can actually ship.

Here you’ll get to:

• Build, coach, and manage a high-performing FDE team, including hiring, performance, and embedding engineers in specific lines of business while keeping them aligned to core tech standards.

• Define, scale, and maintain the FDE technical operating playbook - intake standards, routing rules, reusable delivery models, and engagem

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
About World Business Lenders

•
World Business Lenders (WBL) is a privately held portfolio lender specializing in real estate-secured business loans for underserved businesses. WBL operates with a fully remote, multinational workforce and an experienced executive leadership team.

• Typically, the work schedule is from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday , though additional hours may be required based on business needs.

About the Role

• The Chief Operating Officer is responsible for providing operational leadership and coordination across the Company’s Lending Operations, including Intake, Processing, Valuation, Underwriting, Title, and Closing, as well as Asset Resolution and Loan Administration (Servicing).

• This role will work closely with the senior leadership responsible for each function to ensure these areas operate as an integrated, end-to-end lending and asset lifecycle.

• The Chief Operating Officer will focus on improving coordination within and between departments, establishing consistent processes and performance standards, identifying operational bottlenecks, monitoring key performance indicators, and ensuring that issues are addressed before they negatively impact lending, servicing, or asset resolution.

• The Chief Operating Officer will focus on process integration, performance standards, operational efficiency, cross-functional coordination, and resolution of issues across the broader lending and asset lifecycle.

• The position will report directly to the Chief Executive Officer and will serve as a key operational partner to executive leadership. The role will provide visibility into operational performance, risks, capacity, and opportunities for improvement across the functions within its scope.

What Success Looks Like

• Improve coordination and accountability across Lending Operations, Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration.

• Reduce operational bottlenecks and unnecessary handoffs.

• Improve turnaround times and overall process efficiency.

• Establish clear and measurable operational KPIs and improve visibility into performance for executive leadership.

• Identify and resolve recurring operational issues.

• Build scalable processes capable of supporting the company's continued growth.

• Create a unified and efficient end-to-end operating model across the lending, servicing, and asset-resolution lifecycle.

What You'll Be Doing (Core Responsibilities)

• Operational Leadership

• Provide overall operational oversight across Lending Operations (Intake, Processing, Valuation, Underwriting, Title, and Closing), Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration (Servicing).

• Work directly with the functional leaders of each area to establish priorities, processes, performance expectations, and operational objectives.

• Ensure the functions within Lending Operations, Asset Resolution, and Loan Administration operate as an integrated process, with clear ownership and accountability for cross-departmental workflows.

• Identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and communication breakdowns across the closing and asset lifecycle.

• Develop and maintain standardized operating procedures, workflows, controls, service-level expectations, and escalation processes.

• Monitor operational performance and provide regular updates and recommendations to the CEO.

• Closing Operations Oversight

• Work with Closing Operations leadership to monitor closing, funding, and related operational activities.

• Identify recurring issues affecting Closing Operations or movement through the closing pipeline.

• Coordinate with Valuations, Asset Resolution, Underwriting, Sales, Legal, Finance, and other relevant functions to improve execution.

• Review operational reporting and identify trends requiring management attention.

• Valuations Oversight

• Work with Valuations leadership to ensure valuation activities are properly integrated into closing and asset-resolution processes.

• Highly consultative sales style - ability to sell outcomes and value, not just product features.

• Self-starter mindset - motivated to build pipeline and create opportunities.

Performance Metrics:

• New Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) booked.

• Number of new customer logos acquired.

• Pipeline generation (qualified opportunities per quarter).

• Expansion revenue from existing customers (upsells and cross-sells).

Compensation:

• Competitive Base Salary

• Attractive Incentive for On target earnings (OTE)

Why Join Snic Solutions ?

• Be part of a company pivoting to reshape digital transformation for manufacturers.

• Work closely with a leadership team that values entrepreneurship, outcomes, and career growth.

• Opportunity to build and grow your own territory in a high-potential market.

title: (Freelance) Senior Backend Engineer (m/f/d) - Agent SDK
description:
🎤 Why voize? Because we're more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we're looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 Your Mission: Build the layer every agent moves onto

As Senior Backend Engineer on the team behind our Agent SDK, you build and maintain the Kotlin foundation that our AI agents move onto. Agents have grown into a product surface across verticals and markets, and the layer underneath them needs a permanent owner. Your work makes the cost of the second and third agents visibly less than the first, so feature teams can ship at their own pace.

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

- Build and maintain the SDK as an internal product. You shape the runtime and the client-facing contracts that consuming teams build on. The SDK has a roadmap of its own, and you help set it.

- You build the identity layer that agents run on, so customer-facing agents can write with a real user identity. Your responsibilities may include designing and shipping the auth plumbing, depending on what we have already built by your start date.

- Make every agent observable from the day it launches. You wire telemetry and error reporting into the SDK by default, and you integrate inference and anonymization so the SDK enforces them for every consumer.

- Build the test kit that the SDK still needs. You create it along with the architecture tests that protect the runtime internals, and you build the path that runs every SDK agent against our ML team's evaluation harness before a model change ships.

- Absorb ecosystem change on behalf of consuming teams. You own Koog version bumps and format compatibility, and you set the shared limits on tool output and token usage, so an upgrade lands once in the SDK and reaches everyone from there.

🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table

- Several years of production backend experience on the JVM - Kotlin, Java, Scala or similar. Our stack is Kotlin, and you are ready to work in it.

- You have designed APIs that other engineers build against. An SDK or an internal platform where the contract is the product.

- You have built and maintained integrations, and kept them stable when the system on the other side changed.

- Testing and observability are part of how you build.

- You are drawn to AI agent systems, and to the orchestration and evaluation work underneath them.

🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize

- We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will take on real problems, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

- We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany

- Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

- Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses

- You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up.

✨ Ready to talk? Apply now! 🚀

We look forward to your application and can't wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!

• Troubleshooting: Act as the subject matter expert to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical errors with API connectors, workflows, or data syncs

Requirements
Qualifications:

• At least 5 years in a technical HubSpot development role with specialized experience in marketing automation

• Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, including Sales/ Service Cloud, and experience mapping data to HubSpot

• Deep knowledge of HubSpot Marketing Hub, CRM, CMS, workflows, and API integrations

• Expertise in HubL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and working with REST/SOAP APIs

• Proven experience building advanced workflows, lead scoring models, and segmentation strategies

• Strong communication and collaboration abilities and expound technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
